tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// dpal khrag 'thung chen po'i sgrub thabs yang dag par grub pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// slob dpon hūm̐ ka ra'i rgya gzhung*// ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ saṃ sid+dhi ma hā shrī he ru ka no pi ka nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal khrag 'thung chen po'i sgrub thabs yang dag par grub pa zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das khrag 'thung chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// yang dag grub pa gcig pu nyid// sangs rgyas bde chen kun 'dus pa// rnal 'byor zab mo sku gsum rdzogs// mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde mchog bde// shes rab kyis ni blo phye nas// nges par brtags pa'i sa gzhi la// bla mas nges pa'i lung 'di bstan// snum pa yi ni dam tshig dang*// gtsang dang 'jigs pa'i brtul zhugs can// de dag goms nas nyams su blang*// blo zhan shes rab chung bas ni// bsgrubs kyang 'grub par mi 'gyur te// phud byed gnyis ka sreg pas na// de bas gzhan du bstan pa min// phun sum tshogs pa bzhi ldan nas// rdzas dang sa gzhi brtags pa der// 'byung po'i gtor ma btang nas kyang*// gsang ba'i don gyi las rnams bya// de nas dur khrod bdag po dag /phyag rgya che dang ldan par ni// ci rigs su ni las rnams bya// dkyil 'khor nub phyogs de bzhin bzhi// kham phor ri mor bris pa dgu// snang ba'i 'od dang chas par dgram// rdzas kyis mdzes par 'khor bar bzhag /mig gi rten yang mngon par bzhag /mi dmigs chos la blo brtan cing*// ye shes can gyi byin stobs kyis// thams cad tshul bzhin byin gyis brlab// rtogs pa'i blo can de dag gis// srog lus man chad rdzas kyi rnams// bla ma mnyes par bya phyir 'bul// dngos grub 'dod par gsol ba gdab// slob dpon ji bzhin stan bder gnas// rdo rje'i tshul du dbang dag sbyin// g.yon phyogs gnas la tshul bzhin du// ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du sbyar// gar mkhan tshul 'dra sgyu ma'i rgya// de las 'ja' tshon bzhin du gsal// 'dod chags ye shes gsal ba'i phyir// 'bar ba sna tshogs 'khrigs pa'i 'od// thim pa'i rgyal mor byin gyis brlab// yab yum gnyis med sbyor ba yis// byang chub sems de blangs nas ni// de dag dngos grub chen po bas// ji ltar 'dod par nan tan bya// yid 'ong bkra shis rigs kyi yum// bu la gtad nas man ngag sbyin// dbang thob mdzes pa de dag gis// dul ba'i sems su bzhag nas ni// dam tshig chen pos bde bar gnas// sangs rgyas tshe 'dir bsgrub pa'i phyir// sku gsum sa la goms par bya// dang por chos kyi dbyings nyid la// dmigs pa med pa'i don gyis bsgom// chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyis// thams cad kun la khyab par bya// med pa'i rgyu las mngon gsal ba'i// sems kyi rang bzhin ye shes gsal// cir yang 'gyur ba'i yig 'bru bsam// 'od zer tshul du spros nas kyang*// ma lus snying rjes khyab byas te// re zhing ngam pa'i tshul du dgongs// 'od zer de dag 'dus nas kyang*// rin chen mdzes pa'i gzhal yas su// rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa// thugs rje che dang ldan pa yi// dkyil 'khor lnga la sogs pa'i 'khor// grub pas bstan pa'i lus bzhin du// sku mdog so sor gsal ba yi// phyag rgya rgyan dang cha lugs dag

/bskyed rdzogs grub pa'i lha dag bsgom// zhi ba'i mchod pas mnyes pa dag /bsnyen pa'i don du de dag bya// dngos grub dam shes blang ba'i phyir// lhag pa'i rtags kyis kun mtshan nas// snga ma las ni gnas bsgyur te// dur khrod sa ru brtag par bya// ye shes dam tshig chen po yis// pad+mo rin chen ldan byas nas// bde mchog sgyu ma'i brdas mtshon te// dbyings kyi bde chen 'byung ba de// rang rig ye shes de las 'od// ji bzhin mkha' la gsal ba dag /dri med nyi ma'i 'od pas 'tsher// byang chub sems ni kun tu dag /khams gsum rab tu 'das nas kyang*// ma lus snying rjes khyab byas te// 'dod par bya ba rab tu mnyes// bskal pa'i me phung 'khrigs pa bzhin// khro bos sprul pas dregs pa bsgral// 'od 'dus thog ma'i gzugs la gzud// 'bar ba'i 'khor tshogs rnam par bsam// ye shes dkyil 'khor spyan drangs te// bzhugs dang brtan dang mi g.yo dang*// dam tshig zil gnon phyag byed dang*// mchod dang bstabs dang bza' ba dag /tshul rig goms pa'i blo dag gis// ci rigs su ni brtag par bya// bsnyen par gnang ba'i dbang thob nas// bsgom dbyangs yi ge 'bru brgyad bstan// bsgom rgyud gsal bar ci nus bya// bsnyen pa'i lung bzhin brtson par 'bad// dam tshig mchog gi mchod pa dag /bskul tshig dbyangs kyis de dag mnyes// 'khor bcas mchod pa rdzogs nas ni// dmigs med stobs kyi gdengs can gyis// sku mchog 'bar ba'i tshul du bsam// sgrub rdzas de dag byin gyis brlab// khams gsum khrag tu dmigs nas ni// dur khrod kun tu khyab par bsam// dngos ni a ru byin rlabs nas// rin chen gsal bar shar ba dang*// byang chub sems ni 'od zer 'phros// mos pa'i thugs la mnyes bsams nas// 'od 'dus thog ma'i gzugs la gzud// phyag mtshan snying po phra mo dag /brtan par red nas mkha' la bzhag

/bskul bas rang bzhin kun 'dus pa// des kyang spro ba'i las kun byed// dngos kyang mchod pa'i rdzas su bsngo// bar chad byed pa'i bgegs chen kyang*// 'jigs pa med pa'i sems kyis bzlog /dngos grub sbyin pa'i gzugs can kyang*// re dang dogs dang dga' ba yi// ngan pa'i don gyi sems mi dbyung*// phan gnod byed pa rnam gnyis po// gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ni// rnam pa gsum por byung ba na// dogs dang bcas pa'i sems spangs te// bye brag tu ni shes par bya// nyams kyi phyag rgyas rang don sad// gal te 'byung po mnan par bya// ston pas bstan pa'i lung bzhin du// zhag grangs dus ni brtag pa'am// mtshan ma brtan por byung ba na// sgrub pa chen po brtsam par bya// rdo rje nyi ma nub nas ni// skya rengs 'char ba'i bar du bsgrub// rdzas la hūm̐ dbyangs bstod mchod kyis// dngos grub bsdus te sku gsung thugs// thob dang byin rlabs dbang bskur bya// sbyin sreg las bzlas mkha' 'gro bskyang*// gter sba dkyil 'khor bsdu ba dang*// smon lam bkra shis bro brdungs te// dge bsngo ma dag bshags pa dang*// rgyun gyi ting 'dzin nan tan bya// kun kyang sems can don du bsngo// sgrub pa chen po yang dag par grub pa zhes bya ba grub pa'i slob dpon chen po badz+ra hūm̐ ka ra'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa/ bod kyi lha btsan po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi bka' lung gis dpal nā len+d+ra'i gtsug lag khang du rgya gar gyi mkhan po hūm̐ ka ra de nyid dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de gnubs nam mkha'i snying pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa las/ phyis mchims phu bre gu dge'u ru rig 'dzin gyi rgyal po pad+ma saṃ bha bas rtsa ba nyid la 'khrugs pa go rim bsdebs shing ma tshang ba kha bskang bar mdzad de gsang ba'i 'grel ba dang bcas pa lo tsā ba nam mkha'i snying pos bsgyur nas byang chub sems dpa' khri srong lde'u btsan sogs rje 'bangs bdun la gdams shing bka' rgyas btab pa'o//

// ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
